Welcome to Cyrus Says!
On this episode of Cyrus Says, Cyrus Broacha is joined by rapper Bali for a conversation that starts with music and takes several unexpected detours.
Bali talks about discovering Eminem in school, his early attempts at making rap music, and how he eventually found his own style in the Indian hip-hop scene. He also breaks down his songwriting process, his love for pop-culture references, and why he decided to use Bali instead of his real name, Sachin.
